description: Hand-labeled gold seed corpus for per-adapter precision/recall/F1. Symbols use the adapter's CURRENT emission format (e.g. rust functions render as `name(args)`). Seed is intentionally tiny and unambiguous; it validates the F1 machinery on a known-good (syn-based, pub-only) adapter. Full labeling across all adapters is ongoing — see CALIBRATION.md.

files.note: pub fn + pub unit struct are public; private fn beta is not. Unit struct emits no fields.
pub enum + its variants + pub fn are public; private struct Internal is not.
public def/class/async_def are public surface. The python adapter emits the full declaration text after the keyword (parameters + trailing colon) as `name`; kinds: function/class/async_function.

PEP 8: single-leading-underscore names are internal-by-convention and NOT public surface, so only `public_fn` is gold. The python adapter currently has NO underscore filter and emits `_private_fn`/`_Internal` too -> expected 2 FP (measures a real precision gap against Python convention; fix deferred behind the data).

namespace/public function/interface/public method/class/public const/public property are public; `private string $password` is NOT. PHP classes have no visibility modifier and are public surface. PHP adapter emits bare identifiers for functions/methods (`save`), `$name` for properties.

`abstract class` and `final class` are unambiguously public surface, but the adapter only matches the bare `class ` prefix and misses modifier-prefixed classes -> expected 2 FN (measures a real recall gap; fix deferred behind the data).

module-with-exports + exported function (name/arity) + record + macro are public; non-exported `private_helper` is NOT. The contested no-export-module question stays parked (see CALIBRATION rev-16b); this seed covers only unambiguous surface.

Exported top-level funcs/types (first letter uppercase) are public; lowercase `helper` is not. Names are the full declaration remainder incl. trailing `{`. Receiver methods (`func (s *T) M()`) are NOT emitted by the current adapter — a documented structural recall gap (see CALIBRATION), not seeded as gold because the adapter defines no method emission format to label against.
Top-level decls are public-by-default; `private` is skipped. Names are the full declaration remainder (params/return/brace included).
Only public/open decls are surface; unmarked `hidden` is internal. Names are the full declaration remainder incl. trailing `{`.
defmodule/def are public; defp is private (not matched by the `def ` prefix). Names are the full declaration remainder incl. trailing `do`.
C has no visibility; top-level #define/struct/enum/function are treated as surface. Adapter emits bare identifiers; function name = token before `(`.
C++ has no visibility at namespace scope; namespace/class/struct/free function are surface. Adapter emits bare identifiers.
Only `public`-prefixed types and public methods are surface. `void save();` in the interface lacks an explicit public modifier line match and is not emitted. Adapter emits bare identifiers.

Only explicitly `public` types and public members are surface; kind = the type keyword itself. Interface member `void Save();` has no `public` modifier and is not emitted. Adapter emits bare identifiers.
Ruby has no line-level visibility here; module/class/def/CONSTANT are surface. Adapter emits bare identifiers.
Global (non-local) functions and `M.<name> = ...` module exports are surface; `local M` is not. Adapter emits the full lhs (`M.run`) for module exports, bare name for functions.
Top-level case class/class/object/trait/def are public-by-default surface. Adapter emits bare identifiers; kinds: case_class/class/object/trait/def.
Top-level class/enum/extension/mixin/function are surface (no underscore-prefixed names here). Adapter emits bare identifiers.
defn/defmacro/defprotocol/def are public surface. The `(save [this v])` protocol member line is not a def form and is not emitted. Adapter emits bare identifiers.
Line-based adapter: module/module type/let/val/type are all emitted including inner `let debug` and `val save` — the seed labels exactly what the current adapter emits (no scoping). Bare identifiers.
module/type/let are surface; `let private hidden` is skipped by the adapter's private filter. Kind for let-bound values is `value`. Bare identifiers.
package/use-constant/sub are surface. Adapter emits the full package path (`MyApp::Store`) and bare names for sub/constant.

`export`-prefixed lines are surface; class body method `greet()` is not. Name = first non-keyword identifier (export_name); kind via classify_ts_export. `export default function main` -> name `main`, kind `default_export`.

Adapter parses at TS 4.0: `export type Point` emits BOTH (Point,type_export) and (Point,type) — the seed labels exactly what the adapter emits. Class/interface members without `export` are not emitted.
Top-level function signature AND equation both emit (add,function) — the harness is set-based so the duplicate collapses. data/newtype/class/type emit the first type token. Bare identifiers.

Only <script> content is parsed; defineProps/defineEmits/defineExpose macro lines are surface and the WHOLE trimmed line is the symbol name (macro-granularity emission — see CALIBRATION; finer prop-level granularity is a parked model change).
Only <script> content; `export let` -> prop, `export const`/`export function` -> export. Name = the declaration remainder after the keyword(s). Svelte 4 syntax, so no rune symbols.
Only frontmatter (---) is parsed; `export ` lines -> export (name = remainder), lines containing `Astro.props` -> props (name = whole line).
SCSS variables/mixins/css-vars/@forward are surface. variable/css_var/forward names are the WHOLE trimmed line; mixin name is the remainder after `@mixin ` (trailing `{` included).
CSS custom properties and class selectors with a `{` are surface; the WHOLE trimmed line is the symbol name. `:root {` matches neither prefix rule and is not emitted.
